import hashlib, json, re, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
repo=root/"worktrees"/"covenia-integration"
base="69d78e88c5c2ee0f7cd25c7a04c0eaa8223d0f51"
evidence=repo/"docs/planning/b/plan-merge-2026-09-29"
load=lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
blob=lambda ref,p: subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(repo),"show",f"{ref}:{p}"])
m=load(repo/"batches.json")
w=load(evidence/"WORKSPACE_batches.before.json")
r=json.loads(blob(base,"batches.json"))
wm=(evidence/"WORKSPACE_MASTER_PLAN.before.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
md=(repo/"MASTER_PLAN.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
rm=blob(base,"MASTER_PLAN.md").decode("utf-8")
rows=[]
def ck(name,condition,detail=None):
    rows.append({"check":name,"result":"PASS" if condition else "FAIL","detail":detail})
mb={b["id"]:b for b in m["batches"]}
wb={b["id"]:b for b in w["batches"]}
rb={b["id"]:b for b in r["batches"]}
ck("batch_ids_and_dependency_graph",len(mb)==34 and list(mb)==list(wb)==list(rb) and all(mb[k]["depends_on"]==wb[k]["depends_on"]==rb[k]["depends_on"] for k in mb))
ck("batch_definitions_equal_approved_workspace",m["batches"]==w["batches"],"No batch definition, dependency, path, executable command or status was rewritten.")
ck("allowed_paths_34",all(mb[k]["allowed_paths"]==wb[k]["allowed_paths"] for k in mb))
ck("forbidden_paths_34",all(mb[k]["forbidden_paths"]==wb[k]["forbidden_paths"] and "fixtures/**" in mb[k]["forbidden_paths"] for k in mb))
ck("root_and_repository_plan_mirrors",all((root/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8")==(repo/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in ("MASTER_PLAN.md","batches.json")),"Text equality after CRLF/LF decoding; committed raw blob equality is checked separately after commit, never substituting worktree hashes.")
ck("environment_policy_and_read_only_reload",m["environment_policy"]==w["environment_policy"] and m["scheduling"]["plan_reload"]==w["scheduling"]["plan_reload"] and m["write_policy"]==w["write_policy"])
ck("standing_rules_and_no_autostart",m["scheduling"]["standing_rules"]==r["scheduling"]["standing_rules"] and m["scheduling"]["auto_start_next_batch"] is False)
sec55=lambda t:re.search(r"^### 5\.5 .+?(?=^### 5\.6|^## 6\.)",t,re.M|re.S).group(0).strip()
sec511=lambda t:re.search(r"^### 5\.1\.1 .+?(?=^### 5\.2)",t,re.M|re.S).group(0).strip()
ck("sections_5_5_and_5_1_1_preserved",sec55(md)==sec55(wm) and sec511(md)==sec511(rm))
sec41=lambda t:re.search(r"^### 4\.1 .+?(?=^### 4\.2)",t,re.M|re.S).group(0).split("\n",1)[1].strip()
ck("fixture_handoff_body_preserved_with_completed_label",sec41(wm) in sec41(md) and "已完成 / ACCEPTED（2026-09-13）" in sec41(md))
union=load(evidence/"COMMAND_UNION.json")
ck("command_union_all_source_entries",len(union["mappings"])==485 and union["counts"]=={"workspace":343,"repository":142,"source_entries":485,"merged_executable":343})
for source,bs in (("workspace",wb),("repository",rb)):
    actual=[(x["batch_id"],x["source_index"],x["source_command"]) for x in union["mappings"] if x["source"]==source]
    expected=[(k,i+1,c) for k,b in bs.items() for i,c in enumerate(b["acceptance_commands"])]
    ck("source_commands_preserved_"+source,actual==expected)
ck("every_source_maps_to_active_command",all(mb[x["batch_id"]]["acceptance_commands"][x["executable_index"]-1]==x["executable_command"] for x in union["mappings"]))
prefix='& "<RUN_DIR>/venv/Scripts/python.exe"'
commands=[c for b in m["batches"] for c in b["acceptance_commands"]]
ck("no_bare_python_in_executable_commands",not any(re.match(r"^(python(?:3)?|py|pip|pytest|uvicorn)\b",c) for c in commands))
ck("pip_check_in_every_batch",all(prefix+" -m pip check" in b["acceptance_commands"] for b in m["batches"]))
block_errors=[]
fence=re.escape(chr(96)*3)
for bid,b in mb.items():
    block=re.search(r"^### "+re.escape(bid)+r"｜.+?(?=^### BATCH-|^## 8\.|\Z)",md,re.M|re.S).group(0)
    blocks=re.findall(r"^"+fence+r"powershell\n(.*?)^"+fence,block,re.M|re.S)
    actual=[ln for ln in blocks[0].splitlines() if ln.strip()] if len(blocks)==1 else []
    if actual != b["acceptance_commands"]: block_errors.append(bid)
ck("markdown_json_executable_commands_match",not block_errors,block_errors)
g={v["id"]:v for v in m["external_gates"]}
wg={v["id"]:v for v in w["external_gates"]}
rg={v["id"]:v for v in r["external_gates"]}
ck("four_gate_statuses",all(g[k]["status"]=="ACCEPTED" for k in ["X-FREEZE","X-A-FIXTURES","X-A-MAPPING","X-A-IMAGES"]))
ck("other_gates_and_image_subconditions_unchanged",all(g[k]==wg[k] for k in wg if k not in ["X-A-MAPPING","X-A-FIXTURES"]) and g["X-A-IMAGES"]==rg["X-A-IMAGES"])
ck("existing_fixture_acceptance_fields_retained",all(g["X-A-FIXTURES"][k]==v for k,v in rg["X-A-FIXTURES"].items() if k!="criteria"))
ap=blob(base,"docs/approvals/b-decisions.json")
ck("approval_blob_and_working_bytes_unchanged",hashlib.sha256(ap).hexdigest().upper()=="3ACAD4A113EB595BCED29025AF884A4C5EA2835E90E38D0E897298F91DB371DA" and ap==(repo/"docs/approvals/b-decisions.json").read_bytes()==(root/"docs/approvals/b-decisions.json").read_bytes())
target=blob(base,"handoff/a/data-mapping.json")
receipt=load(repo/"reports/batches/X-A-MAPPING/GATE_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT.json")
ck("mapping_raw_blob_hash_and_receipt",len(target)==74175 and hashlib.sha256(target).hexdigest().upper()==receipt["artifact"]["git_blob_sha256"] and receipt["review_status"]=="PENDING_INDEPENDENT_PLAN_MERGE_REVIEW" and "accepted_by" not in receipt)
old_archive=json.loads(blob("90c83590ad4955e24d6d859c1281b42f53686785","reports/batches/X-A-MAPPING/ARCHIVE_REPORT.json"))
old_verify=json.loads(blob(base,"reports/batches/BATCH-05/VERIFICATION_REPORT.json"))
ck("mapping_existing_acceptance_chain",old_archive["gate_status"]=="ACCEPTED" and any(x["gate_id"]=="X-A-MAPPING" and x["result"]=="PASS" for x in old_verify["external_gate_checks"]))
old_lines=load(root/"docs/decisions/.plan-merge-baseline.json")["master_plan_lines"]
new_lines=[s.strip() for s in md.splitlines() if s.strip()]
missing=[l for l in old_lines if not any(l==s or l in s for s in new_lines)]
ck("repository_text_traceability",not missing,{"missing_lines":len(missing),"historical_archive_not_executable":True})
ck("merge_is_pending_independent_acceptance",m["plan_merge"]["status"]=="MERGED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW")
longest=max((len(str(p)) for p in Path(sys.prefix).rglob("*") if p.is_file()),default=0)
ck("isolated_absolute_interpreter",sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix and Path(sys.prefix).name=="venv" and longest<250)
result={"kind":"IMPLEMENTER_STATIC_SELFCHECK_NOT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION","baseline_commit":base,"python_executable":sys.executable,"sys_prefix":sys.prefix,"longest_venv_path":longest,"checks":rows,"passed":sum(x["result"]=="PASS" for x in rows),"failed":sum(x["result"]=="FAIL" for x in rows),"business_tests_run":False,"batch_dispatch_performed":False}
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
sys.exit(1 if result["failed"] else 0)
